To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Hankelets are a type of features that capture the dynamic properties of tracklets and are useful for cross-view action recognition”.
Hankelets are a new type of features that capture short term dynamics of tracklets, and that they are robust to viewpoint changes.

(i) we introduce a novel type of feature, called “Hankelets”, that captures dynamic properties from short tracklets; (ii) we demonstrate that Hankelets are invariant to changes in viewpoint; and (iii) we show that Hankelets can improve cross-view recognition by more than 20%
